column4: cleat#2668 round 1 (cleat-review): MySQL-only by nature, not by omission -- it settles whether FORCE INDEX (idx_ingested_events_correlate) actually avoids the next-key-locking-across-keys defect that FORCE INDEX (idx_ingested_events_unprocessed) had once cleat#2647 gave the claim query real key equality; PostgreSQL/MSSQL have no equivalent MVCC locking model for this query shape. Checks os.Getenv via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectMySQL) directly (no subtests), so it skips once, at the top level, in ci.yml's test-go/plugins job (PostgreSQL only via CLEAT_TEST_DB) and runs wherever CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL is set. Measured: go test ./plugins/eventtriggers/... -run TestAwaitEventConcurrentClaimsOfDifferentKeysDoNotBlockOnMySQL -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL unset reports exactly this one skip.
